name: Nori Pridedrift
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Nori Pridedrift sends warm Mornbrew out to those who face the cold. He brews and sells the drink, hiring swift couriers to carry it while it is still hot.

sections.title: A Steaming Cup in the Snow
sections.body: Nori Pridedrift sends Scalding Mornbrew across the frozen reaches of Coldridge Valley. The cold bites hard, and a cup brings welcome warmth to mountaineers and freezing sentries. Nori brews the coffee-like drink, then sends it out with couriers who must race the mountain air to keep it scalding. His supply of sturdy mugs is limited, so he expects runners to bring them back promptly.

faq.answer: Nori Pridedrift is a dwarf peddler in Coldridge Valley. He brews and sells Scalding Mornbrew, a hot, coffee-like drink for the local guards and miners.
Scalding Mornbrew is a hot drink brewed by Nori Pridedrift. Valley folk favor it for warmth against the bitter cold of Dun Morogh.

aliases: why does the drink go cold
faq.answer: Scalding Mornbrew is prized while piping hot. The mountain winds in Coldridge Valley cool each cup quickly, so Nori's couriers must hurry to their customers.

faq.q: Why does Nori care so much about returning mugs?
faq.answer: Nori has only a limited supply of drinking mugs in the valley. If customers keep them or break them in the snow, his morning trade soon falters.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the comfort of a strong drink in freezing weather. Nori's hot Mornbrew is welcome at mountain watch posts.
As a cook in Dun Morogh, you can appreciate Nori's care in serving his specialty drink piping hot in the freezing air.
